item.title: Ethiopia expels 6 Sudanese consular staff and orders consulate closed, officials say
item.description: Ethiopia has expelled six staff members of Sudan’s consulate in Assosa, a western city near the Sudanese border, and ordered the mission closed, Ethiopian and Sudanese officials said.

item.title: Drone attacks in Black Sea pose new challenges to Bulgarian border police, in photos
item.description: Bulgarian border police crews are responding to drone attacks on commercial ships in the Black Sea as Russia's war in Ukraine poses growing dangers.

item.title: An Idaho law targeted fentanyl dealers. Prosecutors are using it to charge users, too
item.description: When two Idaho lawmakers pitched harsher penalties for people caught with fentanyl, they said the new law would target drug dealers — not those struggling with addiction.

item.title: Federal judge dismisses case against Russian-born scientist accused of smuggling frog embryos
item.description: A federal judge has granted a government motion to dismiss all charges against a Russian-born scientist who was accused of smuggling frog embryos into the United States.
